title: A collectible lookup answer or error is applied to whichever lookup is open, not the one that asked
trigger: Tap a collectible username/phone row on profile A, then before the answer arrives tap one on profile B (second tap replaces hub.collectible and sends a second request). A's answer (or COLLECTIBLE_NOT_FOUND) lands.
effect: The box for B shows A's purchase date and price under B's name and owner; or A's not-found error marks B failed, so B's link is copied and its real answer is dropped. Applies by purpose only (state/domains/payments/apply.rs:25, error.rs:64); CollectibleLookup holds no request id.
fix: Make the lookup an enum Loading{request: RequestId} / Ready(info) / Failed(reason) and apply an answer or error only when its extra equals the Loading request id.

title: CollectibleLookup stage is loading: bool + info: Option + failed: Option kept in step by hand
trigger: Open a collectible box; the answer sets loading=false and info, an error sets loading=false and failed.
effect: Today all three can be set together or none (request lost leaves loading=true so a repeat tap on the same entity returns Ok(None) and never re-sends; request_collectible_info in connect/payments.rs:293 checks open.loading).
fix: Fetch<CollectibleInfo> (idle/loading/ready/failed) with the request id in the loading variant.

title: Calls 'Clear all' stage is recent_calls_clearing: bool beside recent_calls_request and recent_calls_error
trigger: Open the Calls tab, press Clear all, confirm; while in flight the button hides via can_clear(len, clearing).
effect: Stage is a bool set after send (connect/calls/history.rs:190) and cleared by hand in session_apply_ok.rs:63 and calls/error.rs:92, not matched to the request id; fetch_call_history can clear the list while clearing is true. No bug found today.
fix: One enum for the recent-calls list: Idle/Loading{request}/Ready/Failed/Clearing{request}; can_clear takes the enum.

title: Pasted clipboard images are written to a guessable world-readable temp file that is never deleted
trigger: Paste an image into the composer (or export a peer QR through the same helper), send or discard it, keep using Quill.
effect: The image bytes stay in the system temp dir as quill-paste-<nanos>-<seq>-<pid>.<ext> (default umask, usually readable by other local users) until the OS clears temp; the startup sweep in scratch.rs only covers the quill-send-photos/quill-edits... subfolders, not these files. A guessable name in a shared temp dir is also open to a pre-placed symlink.
fix: Write into the swept per-process work dir (scratch) with create_new and mode 0600, and delete the file when the tray entry is sent, removed or the app exits.

title: A deferred caption for a pending media message is never dropped if the pending message is deleted or cancelled
trigger: Send a photo, press Up to edit the caption while it is uploading, then delete/cancel the pending message so no updateMessageSendSucceeded or Failed arrives for it.
effect: The DeferredCaption stays in session.messages.deferred_captions for the life of the account (only run_deferred_caption on a send outcome removes it). Small leak; no wrong send since temp ids are not reused.
fix: Drop deferred captions in the message-delete reducer, or keep the caption on the pending message row as a PendingSend::CaptionEdited variant so it dies with the row.

title: Birthday suggestion dismissal is an optimistic birthdays_hidden bool reverted by hand
trigger: Dismiss the birthday card: connect/privacy_data.rs:255 sets birthdays_hidden=true after sending; HideContactCloseBirthdays error resets it (session_privacy_data.rs:182); updateContactCloseBirthdays resets it (settings/apply.rs:262).
effect: Works today, but the stage (shown / hiding / hidden) is a bool plus a reset rule in three places, not matched to the dismiss request.
fix: enum BirthdayCard {Shown, Hiding{request}, Hidden} and apply the error only for that request id.

title: A released swipe re-resolves its action when it fires, so a chat state change in the 150 ms spring-back flips the action
trigger: Swipe a row past the threshold with Mute configured while the chat is unmuted, release; another device (or a sync) mutes the chat within 150 ms.
effect: poll() returns only the chat id; chat_swipe_ui.rs:290 perform_swipe_action recomputes the label from current facts, so the action run is Unmute while the panel showed Mute. Tiny window.
fix: Store the resolved SwipeLabel in Release and fire exactly that action.

title: SwipeMachine holds gesture: Option and releases: Vec plus per-gesture direction_set/reached bools
trigger: Trackpad swipe on a chat row.
effect: Explicit machine, tested; Gesture uses direction_set + orientation + reached bools stepped by hand, and the app keeps a poll: Option<Task> as a 'timer running' flag (ui/chat_swipe_ui.rs:36). No bug found: state lives in OnScreen.chat_list and its task is spawn_screen.
fix: Fold direction_set into Orientation::Undecided{no_direction}/..., and make the poll task part of the machine state.

title: Level tap error closes the source but leaves 'speaking' true and never sends is_speaking=false
trigger: Join a group call, unmute and talk, then unplug or lose the microphone so source.error() returns Some
effect: pump_call_audio closes the tap and returns early; speaking and the tracker are not reset, deadline() returns None (no source), and the open retry path (line 344) returns Ok(false) too, so the self tile keeps showing 'speaking' and TDLib is never told false until a reopen succeeds or the call is muted
fix: Route the error arm through the same 'cannot speak' teardown as the wanted==None arm (reset tracker, send false), or make the tap one enum (Closed, Opening, Open{speaking}, Failed{at,error}).

title: CallAudio is a hand-kept machine: source/opening/injected/injected_open/failed_at/error/speaking/read_at
trigger: Any group call with the microphone level tap
effect: Fields must change together (open sets source+clears opening/failed_at/error; close clears opening/read_at but not speaking)
fix: enum Tap { Closed, Opening(Receiver), Open{source, read_at, speaking}, Failed{at, error} }.

title: CallCapture: active Option + failed_at + error kept in step by hand
trigger: Open, lose, and reopen the call microphone
effect: active is None/Opening/Running (DeviceRun) while failed_at and error are separate Options cleared in finish_open and when wanted==None
fix: enum Mic { Off, Active(ActiveCapture), Failed{at, error} }.

title: Screen share spread over chosen/with_audio/active/error here and screen_sharing/screen_share_pending/screen_share_paused in the session
trigger: Pick a source, share, pause by hiding the window, stop
effect: Driver and session each hold part of one share; resets are repeated at four sites (stale, Ended, finish_open Err, wanted none)
fix: enum Share { None, Chosen{source,audio}, Opening, Running{..}, Ended{error} } owned by the driver, session flags derived from it.

title: Share wanted and source chosen but no frame sender: stays 'sharing' with nothing sent and no error
trigger: Start screen share in a call whose engine is unavailable or has not created external sources (external_frame_sender returns None)
effect: pump_shared_screen returns silently every pump; the session says screen_sharing, the call window shows the share as live, but no capture is opened and call_screen.error is never set
fix: Waiting-for-engine as an explicit Share stage with a timeout/error that ends the share via stop_sharing_screen.

title: Failed screen-pause toggle is never retried and shows a generic voice chat error
trigger: Share a window in a group call, hide it (pause edge), toggleGroupCallScreenSharingIsPaused fails
effect: set_screen_paused already stored active.paused/call.screen_share_paused; the request uses the ToggleGroupCallVideo purpose so the error arm only sets group_call_error 'Voice chat request failed'; later pumps see no edge, so the server keeps showing the share unpaused
fix: Own purpose for the pause toggle whose error arm reverts the flag, or resend while server and local state differ.

title: rating_sent is set before the answer and the SendCallRating error arm never clears it
trigger: End a call, rate it, TDLib sendCallRating fails (offline, flood)
effect: summary.rating_sent stays true so the rating card is gone (call_ui hides on rating_sent) and send_call_rating refuses; only a calls.error line shows; the rating cannot be retried
fix: Rating as enum Rating{Asking, Sending(RequestId), Sent}; the error arm returns to Asking (as SendCallLog does for log_sent).

title: send_call_log has no in-flight guard and does blocking file IO on the UI thread; stale log file left
trigger: Click 'upload call log' twice quickly
effect: Two sendCallLog requests are sent (log_sent only becomes true on ok) and call-<id>.log is written synchronously under exports each time
fix: CallLog stage enum (Idle, Sending(RequestId), Sent, Failed) checked before the write.

title: Recent calls list is a hand-made Fetch: recent_calls + offset + error bool + request Option + clearing bool
trigger: Open Recent calls, page, clear all, switch tabs
effect: fetch_call_history resets four fields by hand; recent_calls_clearing is a stage bool cleared only on ok/error
fix: Fetch<Paged<Call>> plus a Clearing(RequestId) variant.

title: Call privacy: privacy_pending counter + privacy_error + optimistic Options
trigger: Open call privacy settings and change a rule while the first fetch is in flight
effect: fetch/set error paths zero privacy_pending while other requests are still in flight (answers then decrement saturating); a failed set clears the optimistic value to None with nothing refetching it
fix: Per-setting Fetch<PrivacyWho> with optimistic Saving{previous,new} variant.

title: maybe_finish_leave_deletes takes the whole queue and drops the rest on the first error
trigger: Delete and leave several basic groups; leaveChat answers; the first removeChatFromList send returns Err (chats path inactive or native send failure)
effect: delete_after_leave was emptied with mem::take and `?` returns, so the failing chat and all later ones are never deleted: the group is left but stays in the chat list
fix: Peek/drain one at a time, or put unsent chat ids back on error (as maybe_finish_folder_removals does).

title: reorderChatFolders and toggleChatFolderTags are applied optimistically with no rollback and no error arm
trigger: Drag a folder tab / flip folder tags while TDLib refuses or errors
effect: apply_folder_order / are_folder_tags_enabled stay at the refused value (no PendingRequest.rollback set, no arm in chat_list/error.rs) and no error line shows, until a later updateChatFolders
fix: Attach RequestRollback::{FolderOrder, FolderTags} like ChatPinOrder and add error arms.

title: Remove-from-folder chain: folder_remove_queue + folder_specs + folder_specs_stale + in-flight EditChatFolder/GetChatFolder
trigger: Remove a chat from a folder twice in a row, or while an edit is in flight
effect: Queue intent, fetch spec, edit, mark stale is a four-step machine kept by purpose lookups; a chat missing from session.chats is skipped (continue) yet counted as removed
fix: Per-folder enum FolderEdit{Queued(chats), FetchingSpec, Editing(RequestId)}.

title: archive_settings_loading bool beside archive_chat_list_settings Option
trigger: Open archive settings; fetch fails
effect: Loading is a bool kept in step with the cached Option and cleared in apply and error arms
fix: Fetch<ArchiveChatListSettings>.

title: select_chat_open sets session.open_chat before send_open_chat; a send error leaves the chat 'open' without openChat
trigger: Select a chat while the TDLib send fails once (native error)
effect: `?` returns Err but session.open_chat is set; re-selecting the same chat takes the 'already open' branch (line 56) and never sends openChat, so TDLib does not deliver open-chat updates/read marks for it
fix: Open as a stage (Opening/Open) with the TDLib openChat result, or roll back open_chat on error. Same in open_chat_window (chat_window.rs:29).

title: deselect_chat returns early on a send error and leaves session.open_chat set after the main window cleared its chat
trigger: Move the open chat to its own window while cancel_outgoing_typing or closeChat fails to send
effect: `?` at lines 122-123 skips leave_open_chat, so the session still treats the chat as shown (chat_is_shown): new messages are auto-viewed/read while the main window shows nothing; draft_clock/pending_draft were not reset
fix: Do the local teardown first (leave_open_chat), then send the TDLib closes best-effort.

title: close_open_chat / send_open_chat / close_chat_window register a pending request and do not take it when the send fails
trigger: closeChat or openChat send returns Err
effect: session.request(..) entry stays in requests.pending for the life of the session (every other site calls requests.take(extra)); chat_window.rs:107, composer.rs:349 and :360
fix: Use the send-or-take helper (send_json_request) in these three sites.

title: A failed draft send leaves the slot marked dirty with nothing pending
trigger: Type in the composer; the debounced or flushed setChatDraftMessage send returns Err
effect: mark_draft_dirty ran, pending_draft/draft_clock were cleared before send_draft (Write arm line 117-119, commit_debounced_draft take()), the error is returned and dropped by callers; the slot stays dirty so drafts saved from other devices are ignored (per the deselect_chat comment) and the draft is never retried
fix: Keep the pending draft until send_draft succeeds (Draft stage: Clean, Dirty, Debouncing{token}, Sending).

title: Draft save pipeline: pending_draft Option + draft_clock + draft_save_token + session dirty flag
trigger: Type in two slots (main and a chat window)
effect: One save waits at a time; settle/flush/cancel paths each reset clock and pending by hand (seven sites)
fix: enum DraftSave { Idle, Waiting{slot, started, token, content}, Sending(RequestId) }.

title: One session-wide mention_search is searched against session.open_chat, shared by main and chat-window composers
trigger: Type '@x' in a chat window composer while the main window shows another group or no chat
effect: search_mentions uses session.open_chat (the main window's chat unless the caller entered the window view) and stores a single Option, so a window can show or clear the other window's suggestions
fix: Key the search by (window, chat) or store it in the window's ChatUi.

title: Contacts list: contacts Option + contacts_error bool + in-flight purpose
trigger: Open Contacts, add/delete a contact (list set to None) while offline
effect: refetch_invalidated_contacts re-derives loading from three places; a send failure sets contacts_error by hand
fix: Fetch<Vec<UserId>>.

title: Chat media counts: entry is inserted before six requests; a failed filter leaves a zero count forever
trigger: Open the info panel; one getChatMessageCount fails
effect: chat_media_counts[chat] is inserted as default and never re-asked ('once per chat per session'); the failing filter shows 0
fix: Per-filter Fetch<i32> that retries on reopen.

title: Failed chat link delete keeps the row removed from the list
trigger: Delete a business chat link; deleteBusinessChatLink fails
effect: delete_chat_link removes the row optimistically; the error arm (business_extra.rs MutateChatLink) only sets the error text for Delete (no saving decrement, no re-ask: chat_links_requested stays true), so the link is hidden though it still exists
fix: Rollback of the removed row, or reset chat_links_requested in the Delete error arm so the list is asked again.

title: lookup_business_bot records the query before the sends; a failed second/third send leaves it unresolved for the same text
trigger: Type a bot username while mine/global send fails
effect: lookup.query is set, Exact sent, `?` returns on Mine; typing the same text again returns early at line 179, so mine/global stay None (loading) until the text changes
fix: Set lookup.query only after all three parts are sent, or mark failed parts.

title: Business page loads: chat_links_requested/connected_bot_requested bools, chat_links_saving counter, business.saving Vec, one shared business.error
trigger: Open Business pages, save several settings, one fails
effect: 'requested' bools are reset on error/ok by hand; every new save does `business.error = None`, wiping another save's error before it was seen
fix: Fetch<T> for links and bot; per-kind Saving/Failed(error) map instead of one error string.

title: Time zones: time_zones Option + time_zones_requested bool; own info: user_full_infos presence + own_info_error + in-flight purpose
trigger: Open Business hours/location offline
effect: Stage derived from a bool plus an Option; reset on send error and TDLib error separately
fix: Fetch<Vec<TimeZone>> and Fetch<UserFullInfo>.

title: ClosingSet: close_held_until Option in the driver + restart bool + unconfirmed set; close_all_within/Drop block the calling thread
trigger: Quit or drop a ClosingSet while clients are closing
effect: close sent either at once or after a hold timer that only drain_bridged releases; a client unconfirmed stays blocked for the process; Drop sleeps up to 1.5 s on whichever thread drops the set
fix: enum Closing { Holding{until}, Sent, Closed, Lost } per client; keep the blocking wait to the quit path only.

title: 1:1 call media is driven by CallTransport enum plus call_devices_warmed bool, call_devices_listing Option, call_sound_watch Option, camera_on/screen_sharing/muted intent flags
trigger: Place a call, toggle camera and screen share before the transport exists
effect: Intent flags (camera_on, screen_sharing, muted) are stored on the call and replayed at connect; camera/screen share clear each other by hand (set_call_camera:337, set_call_screen_share:379) without telling the engine of the other track
fix: enum LocalVideo { Off, Camera, Screen } on the call.

title: ingest returns early with ? after the reducer took the pending request, dropping answers captured before apply
trigger: A link-preview, message-link, AI-compose, username-check or instant-view answer arrives in the same envelope while run_post_ingest_pumps, maybe_continue_boost, maybe_load_main_chats, maybe_load_archive_chats or sync_shown_views returns a send error (sender closed).
effect: The captured answer is never stashed: composer chip stays 'Getting link info', copy link / AI text / username verdict / instant view silently lost.
fix: Run the stash steps before any fallible step, or collect errors and return the first at the end as run_post_ingest_pumps does.

title: request_close restores shutdown on send failure but not the logout_request that begin_close cleared
trigger: A logOut is in flight (logout_request Some), then request_close is called and its send fails.
effect: shutdown goes back but auth_state.logout_request stays None, so TDLib's logOut answer is no longer matched.
fix: Make begin_close return an undo token or save/restore both fields together (one ShutdownPhase carrying the logout request).

title: maybe_send_parameters leaves the SetParameters pending entry when send_json fails
trigger: setTdlibParameters send fails (sender closed) on kickoff or an ingest; every later ingest registers another SetParameters request.
effect: Pending registry accumulates dead SetParameters entries until swept; parameters_sent bool shadows the WaitTdlibParameters stage.
fix: take(extra) on send failure like the other senders; derive 'sent' from the auth stage instead of a bool.

title: BatchState is open + three dirty bools + a waiting-file set kept in step by hand
trigger: Each envelope in a poll batch sets dirty flags; end_batch takes them and runs the passes.
effect: No bug today; end_batch takes the flag before the pass runs, so a send error in run_shown_media loses that pass until another update dirties it (S4).
fix: One enum Batch{Closed, Open{dirty: PassSet}} and take a pass only after it succeeded.

title: A finished deep-link flow (ShowText / ChatReady) blocks every later link until the UI consumes it
trigger: A launch link ends in ShowText or ChatReady while the surface that consumes it is not drawn (locked, window closed), then another tg:// link is opened.
effect: request_deep_link_info returns Ok(None) for each new link; links silently do nothing until the stale state is consumed.
fix: Let a new launch link replace any non-ResolvingInfo stage, or give every stage an owner window and a Farewell closer.

title: Deep-link flow keeps DeepLinkState plus a separate origin bool, original string and generation counter
trigger: request_deep_link_info / continue_deep_link / confirm_deep_link_invite each set several fields.
effect: No bug found; answers are matched by generation. deep_link_from_agent and deep_link_original live outside the enum and are overwritten on every start.
fix: Carry origin and original link inside the DeepLinkState variants.

title: resume_disk_paused_found takes the whole due list, then returns on the first toggle error
trigger: Several found paused downloads are due and the first toggle_download_paused send fails.
effect: The remaining ids were already mem::taken and are never resumed; save_disk_pauses_if_changed is skipped.
fix: Keep ids queued until each is sent, and always run the save step.

title: disk_resume_searched bool + disk_search_keys + SearchDiskPausedDownloads request + disk_resume_due form one search stage
trigger: Healthy disk with saved pauses starts the once-per-session search.
effect: No bug today (flag reset on send failure, but an error answer leaves it true by design).
fix: enum DiskSearch{Idle, Asked{keys}, Done}.

title: open_earn_page marks TON/Stars Loading then returns early on the first send error
trigger: Open a revenue page when a send fails (TonStats or StarStats, not only TonTransactions).
effect: page.ton / page.stars stay Load::Loading forever, later requests (stars history, ad account) are never sent.
fix: Mark Loading only per request after it is sent, or fail all marked loads on any send error.

title: fetch_earn_balances records the peer as asked before sending and an error answer never clears it
trigger: Open a channel/bot profile when the balance request fails (apply_earn_error ignores TonBalance/StarBalance) or the send fails.
effect: The balance row never loads again for that peer in this session; balances_asked only grows.
fix: Fetch<T> per peer balance (Idle/Loading/Ready/Failed) instead of a visited Vec.

title: Program-list answers are not keyed to the sort or request that asked them
trigger: In the affiliate join page change 'Sort by' twice quickly, or scroll for more while changing sort.
effect: SearchPrograms{for_box,append} is the only key: an older answer lands in the reset list (wrong order shown until the later answer; a stale append adds old-sort rows to the new list). fetch_found_programs also sends a second non-append page while one is loading.
fix: Carry a generation in SearchPrograms and in ProgramList, drop mismatched answers, and gate non-append starts on is_loading.

title: ConnectedPrograms answer is not keyed to the join page's peer
trigger: Open the join page for peer A, then for peer B before A's connected list answers.
effect: A's list is written into B's join.mine (replaced when B's own answer lands).
fix: Add peer/generation to the purpose and compare in the reducer.

title: Recipients load is recipients Option + recipients_loading counter + pending_join + join_box
trigger: open_bot_affiliate_join / open_affiliate_program ask two requests and park the join box until both answered.
effect: If the second send fails after the first went out, recipients_loading is reset to 0 while the first answer later fills recipients with a partial list (user + channels, no bots) that is then cached for the session (S4).
fix: enum Recipients{Idle, Loading{chats,bots}, Ready(Vec)} and a join box that carries its own wait.

title: Earn withdrawal / setup / join / revoke each hold stage flags beside Options
trigger: Collect/Withdraw, save program, join program, revoke link.
effect: Withdraw is matched by request id (waits_for) so no bug found; Password{sending:bool}, SetupPage.saving/confirm, EarnState.setup_closed, JoinBox.joining, Revoke.sending are stage bools.
fix: Make joining/sending part of the step enum (Idle/Sending{request}).

title: end_starref_program closes the confirmation (confirm = None) before the send can fail
trigger: Confirm 'End program' while the send fails.
effect: Confirmation box disappears as if ended; nothing was sent.
fix: Clear confirm only after the send succeeded.

title: status_open / chat_status_open are only cleared by the media panel mode setter on the current account
trigger: Open the emoji-status selector, then switch accounts (or lose the panel) without leaving Status mode through set_media_panel_mode.
effect: The old session keeps status_open=true, so every ingest of that background account keeps resolving status emoji (getCustomEmojiStickers) and a later failure writes status_note.
fix: Move the open flag into OnScreen/WindowSlot state and close it in the Farewell.

title: One shared emoji.failed bool is cleared by any emoji_set_request, hiding an earlier failure
trigger: A status change send fails (failed=true, status_note set), then another unrelated emoji pack request is sent.
effect: failed is reset to false by the unrelated request; the stage of the failed action is lost (status_note remains).
fix: Per-action Fetch<()> instead of a shared failed flag.

title: ensure_emoji_pack_covers marks covers requested before ensure_media_files succeeds
trigger: Open the pack browser when the media request send fails.
effect: Those set covers are never requested again.
fix: Insert into covers_requested only after the download request went out.

title: Emoji pack browser stage is open + tab + trending_offset + mutating_set + mutation_failed + search_query
trigger: Open the browser, switch tabs, install/remove a pack.
effect: No bug found; stale tab answers are dropped by take_purpose.
fix: enum EmojiBrowser{Closed, Open{tab, mutation: Idle|Changing|Failed}}.

title: pump_call_audio errors are mapped to 'changed' every poll
trigger: A group call is active and send_speaking keeps failing (sender closed).
effect: request_tick returns true every poll, forcing a redraw loop.
fix: Treat a send error as unchanged and surface it once.

title: Add-folder-by-link dialog is folder_invite_link + info + error + done + request
trigger: Open an addlist link: check_folder_invite_link resets four fields and sets request.
effect: If the send fails, link is Some with info/error None and no request: dialog shows no result and no error (S3 plausible).
fix: enum FolderInvite{Idle, Checking{link,request}, Ready{..}, Failed{..}, Adding{..}, Done}.

title: process_folder_new_chats removes the new-chats bar before the answer and nothing restores it on failure
trigger: Tap 'Add' or dismiss on the shared-folder new-chats bar and the request fails.
effect: The bar is gone, chats not joined, no error shown; fetch_folder_new_chats is also stamped once per period (asked is set before the send), so it does not come back for the period.
fix: Remove the bar on success only (or keep it Processing{request}) and stamp asked on answer.

title: Saved sublists: topics_requested/topics_exhausted bools, SavedTagSearch.request Option, history.loaded_complete
trigger: Open Saved Messages, scroll sublists, filter by tag.
effect: No bug found; topics_requested is reset on error and the tag request is matched by id.
fix: Fetch<Page> per list.

title: GIF panel stage is open + search_mode + search_loading + search_failed + loading + loaded + failed + stale
trigger: Open GIF panel, search, switch back to saved, bot username changes (core/mod.rs gif_bot_changed).
effect: No bug found; errors reset search_loading. The ingest loop re-calls maybe_search_gifs every envelope while search_loading is true.
fix: enum GifPanel{Saved(Fetch), Search{query, Fetch, next}}.

title: GIF search asks the inline bot with the main window's open chat, not the chat of the panel's window
trigger: Open the GIF panel in a chat window while the main window shows another chat (or none).
effect: getInlineQueryResults carries the wrong chat id (0 when none).
fix: Pass the asking window's chat into search_gifs.

title: open_send_gift_to replaces the whole send state while a sendGift is in flight
trigger: Press Send in the send-gift dialog, close the dialog (close_send_gift keeps sending=true), reopen the dialog for any user before the answer.
effect: SendGiftState is reset (sending=false, request=None), so the Send button is live again and the first answer is dropped by waits_for; a second Send spends Stars again and the first outcome is never shown.
fix: Refuse to open (or keep the in-flight purchase) while send is Sending{request}; model send as enum Idle/Sending/Done/Failed.

title: limits_asked is set before the limit requests and send failures are ignored; GetGiftCollections answers are not keyed by owner
trigger: Open a gifts list when the option sends fail; or open owner A's gifts then owner B's before A's collections answer.
effect: Limits are never asked again this session; A's collections can fill B's list until B's own answer lands.
fix: Carry the owner in the purpose and compare; Fetch<Limits>.

title: Gift management is gift_mutating + gifts_error + note, collections_loading/stale, export_unlocked and TransferStage::Password{sending}
trigger: Pin, upgrade, transfer, delete, export-to-Fragment.
effect: No bug found beyond the entry above; the reducer unlocks on the answer and settle_lost_request clears it.
fix: enum GiftMutation{Idle, InFlight{request, purpose}, Failed} and put export_unlocked into the transfer stage.

title: start_gift_resale_buy / open_gift_resale / open_gift_craft replace buy and craft sessions that have a request in flight
trigger: Start a purchase (buy.sending, Stars spent), then start another buy, open another resale list, or open the craft box before the answer.
effect: The old ResaleBuy/CraftSession is dropped: its answer is ignored (outcome unseen) and the new buy is not sending, so the user can pay twice.
fix: Refuse to replace while sending/crafting; make ResaleBuy a stage enum.

title: follow_gift_auction sets followed before the open request and never unfollows on logout or account switch
trigger: Open an auction box when the follow send fails; or leave the box open and switch accounts.
effect: followed = new id, so the retry returns early (updates never start); the old account stays subscribed to auction updates.
fix: Set followed after the send succeeds; close the follow in the owner's Farewell.

title: Gift market uses ResaleSearch loading/loaded/error, candidates_loading, auction_loading/ready/request, bidding, buy.sending, craft.crafting
trigger: Resale browsing, auctions, bidding, crafting.
effect: Answers are matched by stored request ids; no bug found beyond the replace case above.
fix: Fetch<Page> per list and a Purchase enum.

title: GiftValueLookup is request + loading + info + error + open
trigger: Tap the Value row's learn more.
effect: No bug found; answers match lookup.request and another gift replaces the lookup.
fix: enum GiftValue{Loading{request}, Ready{info, open}, Failed}.

title: Giveaway options keep premium_loading/stars_loading with premium_error/stars_error pairs
trigger: Open the giveaway form for a channel.
effect: Both loading+error pairs can be set; an answer for an earlier boosted chat is not keyed (S3 plausible if the form is reopened for another channel).
fix: Fetch<Options> keyed by boosted chat.

title: AwardMembers has loading bool beside generation, offset and query
trigger: Search or scroll the 'Choose members' list.
effect: No bug found; answers are generation-matched.
fix: Fetch<Page> with generation inside.

title: grams_tick records asked_users/asked_chats even when the lookup send failed
trigger: Open My Grams while a peer lookup send fails.
effect: That peer is never asked again, its row keeps the bare id.
fix: Insert into the asked set only when the send succeeded.

title: My Grams page is open + loading + loaded + error + request + probed + peers_dirty
trigger: Open My Grams, switch All/Incoming/Outgoing.
effect: No bug found; restart replaces the request id.
fix: Fetch<TxPage> per filter.

title: Protected-content rollback restores the flag but not the private_sharing disabled record
trigger: In a private chat turn sharing off and the request fails.
effect: set_chat_protected(previous) restores the flag, but private_sharing.record_disabled stays, so the chat shows 'you disabled sharing' for an unchanged chat.
fix: Put the record into the rollback or record it on success only.

title: admin_followups are removed only when a real envelope answers; swept or settled requests keep them
trigger: A basic group upgrade or history toggle request is swept (stale TTL) or settled by logout while a followup is queued.
effect: The followup stays in groups.admin_followups forever and the chained step (link, topics, history) never runs and no error note appears.
fix: Drop and fail followups in settle_lost_request.

title: Login review counter stays above zero when a send fails mid-loop
trigger: Two or more unconfirmed logins are listed; the user presses 'Yes, it's me' / 'No' and the sender fails on the 2nd or later confirmSession/terminateSession.
effect: review_pending is set to ids.len() but the error path calls finish_login_review once (decrements by 1) and returns; the ids never sent never answer, so review_pending stays > 0, the alert shows busy for good and review_unconfirmed_sessions is refused (needs restart).
fix: Track the review as one enum (Idle / Reviewing{outstanding: BTreeSet<RequestId>} / Failed / Done) keyed by request ids; a failed send removes every unsent id.

title: Login review is four fields kept in step by hand
trigger: Review of new-login alert.
effect: review_pending, review_confirmed, review_error and review_outcome together encode Idle/Reviewing/Failed/Done.
fix: enum LoginReviewStage { Idle, Reviewing{confirmed, outstanding}, Failed(String), Done(LoginReview) }.

title: Terms accept is terms_in_flight + terms_error beside terms
trigger: Accept terms of service.
effect: In-flight flag and error line are cleared by hand on the ok and error arms.
fix: enum TermsStage { None, Offered(Terms), Accepting(Terms), Failed(Terms, String) }.

title: Change-number flow is loading/checking bools plus phone/timeout/error options
trigger: Settings > change phone number.
effect: change_number_loading, change_number_checking, change_number_phone, change_number_timeout, change_number_error are cleared in four different places (apply, error, session_apply_ok) and the check deliberately may overlap a resend.
fix: enum ChangeNumber { Idle, Sending, CodeSent{phone,timeout,resending}, Checking{phone}, Failed{..} }.

title: One password_state_loading bool serves every 2FA operation
trigger: Any two-step verification action (fetch, set, recover, reset, login email).
effect: password_state_loading + password_op_error + password_state are shared by ten ops; the ok, error, passwordState, emailCodeInfo and resetPasswordResult arms each have to clear the flag, and a request refused by the guard is silently dropped (InvalidRequest).
fix: Fetch<PasswordState> plus an Option<PasswordOp> in-flight marker keyed by RequestId.

title: 'Code sent to' marker is cleared before the in-flight guard can refuse the request
trigger: A 2FA op is in flight (password_state_loading); user presses Forgot password / sets a login email / retries.
effect: request_twofa_recovery_code (463) and set_login_email (521) set twofa_flow.*_sent_to = None, then password_op_send returns InvalidRequest. The emailed code is still valid but the dialog drops back from the code step to the start step.
fix: Clear the marker in the answer/ack arm (or in a Sending stage) only after the request was accepted.

title: Password sign-in, recovery request and recovery code submit have no in-flight guard
trigger: On the 2FA sign-in screen press Enter/click twice on 'Forgot password?' (or submit on a slow link).
effect: submit_password, request_password_recovery and submit_recovery_code (unlike login_request/submit_phone) never check has_purpose/has_auth_submit; a double click sends two recovery e-mails (2nd answers 429 into last_auth_error), the UI sets recovery_mode before any answer.
fix: Route all three through login_request (one request per purpose) and set recovery_mode only on the answer.

title: Sign-in screen re-asks getCountries/getCountryCode every frame when the answer is empty or an error
trigger: Open the sign-in phone screen (WaitPhoneNumber) with no network, a TDLib error, an empty country list, or a getCountryCode text that is not two letters.
effect: frame_upkeep runs sync_signin every frame, which calls fetch_countries and fetch_country_code. The guards are 'countries.is_some()' / 'guessed_country_iso.is_some()' and have_purpose; the Countries arm only stores a non-empty list, the Text arm only a valid ISO, and GetCountries/GetCountryCode have no error arm, so after each answer the next frame sends the request again (request loop at round-trip rate).
fix: Hold both as Fetch<T> (Idle/Loading/Ready/Failed) so a finished-but-empty or failed answer is not 'ask again'.

title: Login-URL button context is one session slot, not matched to the request that asked
trigger: Press login-URL button A in a bot message, then button B (same or another chat) before A's getLoginUrlInfo answers.
effect: send_login_url_info/send_login_url overwrite bots.login_url_request; the answer for A is paired with B's chat/message/button_id/raw_url, so the confirmation box shows A's domain but 'Allow' calls getLoginUrl for B's button (authorises the wrong link). Errors and last_login_url_info are single slots too; a failed send leaves a stale request in the slot.
fix: Put the LoginUrlRequest into the RequestPurpose (GetLoginUrlInfo{request}) so the answer carries its own context, and keep at most one box per button.

title: A group bot user whose getUser send failed is never asked again
trigger: Open a group whose bot_commands name unknown bots while the sender is failing.
effect: asked_bot_users.insert(user_id) happens before the send; on send error the id stays in the set, so later ticks skip it and the bot's commands never show in the / menu for the session.
fix: Insert into asked only after a successful send, or keep a Fetch<()> per user.

title: Inline query is a slot enum plus waiting/armed/token side state in the UI
trigger: Typing '@bot query' in the composer.
effect: inline_query slot (Loading/Loaded/Failed) is correct, but 'a newer query waits' lives in chat_ui.inline_query_waiting (bool), inline_query_armed (Option) and composer_ui.inline_query_token, kept in step with the slot by hand.
fix: Make the queued query a variant of the slot (InlineQueryFetch::Loading{queued: Option<String>}).

title: Which theme a default-wallpaper answer belongs to is a session field, not part of the request
trigger: Set a wallpaper for the light theme and, before its answer, one for the dark theme (or the reverse).
effect: set_default_background(_local) writes chats_state.background_set_for_dark; the Background answer reads it at arrival, so the first answer is stored under the second request's theme.
fix: Carry for_dark_theme in RequestPurpose::SetDefaultBackground{for_dark}.

title: Wallpaper deletions are applied locally and not rolled back when TDLib refuses
trigger: Delete the account wallpaper / an installed wallpaper / a chat wallpaper while offline-ish or when the server errors.
effect: delete_default_background (94), remove_installed_background (119) and delete_chat_background (264) remove the entry on send; the error arm in chats/error.rs only sets background_error, so the wallpaper stays gone locally until a refetch/reopen although the server kept it.
fix: Apply on the answer (or keep a Removing stage that the error arm reverts).

title: Business bot bar flips/disappears locally and stays that way when the request fails
trigger: Pause/resume or remove the business bot in a chat and the request errors.
effect: toggle_business_bot_paused and remove_business_bot_from_chat call set_business_bot_bar right after sending; the ToggleBusinessBotPaused/RemoveBusinessBotFromChat error arms only set chat_action_error, so the bar shows the wrong paused state (or is gone) until the chat is re-parsed.
fix: Keep the old bar in the pending request and restore it on the error arm, or wait for updateChatBusinessBotManageBar.

title: Shared wallpaper link lands in the clipboard after the preview was left
trigger: Press Share in the wallpaper preview, close it (or open another wallpaper) before getBackgroundUrl answers.
effect: background_url is an ownerless Option slot cleared only when a preview opens/closes; the answer sets it afterwards and the poll drain copies it to the clipboard without checking that a preview for that background is still open.
fix: Match the answer to the preview that asked (request id in the preview) and drop it otherwise.

title: Appearance page re-requests installed backgrounds on every render after a failure
trigger: Open Settings > Appearance when getInstalledBackgrounds errors.
effect: settings_window/pages.rs:98 calls ensure_wallpapers_loaded on every render; installed_backgrounds stays None after an error and the in-flight dedupe only covers the pending request, so each re-render (the error sets background_error) sends a new request.
fix: Fetch<Vec<Background>> with a Failed stage and an explicit retry.

title: A cover picked for one replacement video is kept for the next video or the original
trigger: Edit a video message: Replace with video X, Edit Cover, then replace with video Y or press Clear replacement, then Save.
effect: media_edit.cover is never cleared when the replacement changes (copy_inline_text.rs:60-84 only resets video_extras for a different path); effective_cover only checks that a video applies, so the old cover is sent with Y, or with the original video after the replacement is cleared.
fix: Put cover and extras inside EditMediaReplacement so replacing or clearing it replaces them whole.

title: 'Send as a document' for an edit replacement is window state, the edit is chat state
trigger: Tick 'Send as a document' while editing media in chat A, switch to chat B that has its own edit in progress, pick a replacement file.
effect: edit_replace_as_file lives in ComposerUi (per window) and is reset only in begin_edit and clear_edit_replacement; chat B's edit inherits chat A's choice.
fix: Store as_file in EditMediaReplacement / MediaEdit in the ChatUi.

title: photo_render Option<u64> marks 'rendering' next to path/kind/file_name
trigger: Done in the photo editor on a tray photo.
effect: photo_render, path, photo_jpeg, file_only, kind, file_name are rewritten together by land_attachment_edit; a send is blocked while photo_render is Some.
fix: enum AttachmentFile { Ready(PathBuf), Rendering{render, from: PathBuf} }.

title: gif and sound_removed are two bools that must change together
trigger: Video editor 'remove sound' / GIF choice.
effect: sound_removed is only meaningful when gif is set; gif also depends on cover/edits/source set in step.
fix: enum VideoKind { Video, Gif{sound_removed: bool} } and group source+edits in one Option<VideoEdit>.

title: schedule_repeat_period is only valid beside scheduling = SendAtDate
trigger: Schedule a message with a repeat period, then switch to send-when-online.
effect: Doc says 'ignored unless scheduling is a send date': two fields that must agree.
fix: ComposerScheduling::SendAtDate{date, repeat_period}.

title: Draft save clock is an Option used as an 'armed' flag
trigger: Typing in the composer.
effect: started_ms None/Some is the armed stage; the caller (connect/composer.rs) must reset it to idle at every Write, chat switch and send.
fix: enum DraftClock { Idle, Armed{first_edit_ms} } owned by the draft target.

title: Composer document keeps text, span ranges and emoji ranges in step by hand
trigger: Any edit in the composer field.
effect: spans/emoji hold byte ranges into text; writer.rs:104 and :252 defensively drop ranges that an edit left stale or off a char boundary.
fix: Edit the doc only through methods that map ranges (a rope with attached spans) so stale ranges cannot exist.

title: Two separate adjacent quotes become one quote after markup round trip
trigger: Quote line 1 and quote line 2 as two separate block quotes on adjacent lines, then send or reopen the draft.
effect: The markup writes '> a\n> b' and push_quote_line (markup_parser.rs:167) merges consecutive quote lines, so the distinct quote spans are merged; to_final_markup sees from_markup(markup) != self and falls back to the same text.
fix: Separate adjacent quotes need an explicit marker in markup, or normalize them to one in the doc.

title: A failed presentation connect clears the local screen-share flags but never ends the screen share TDLib already started
trigger: Start screen share in a joined group call; startGroupCallScreenSharing answers, then engine.connect_screen_share fails
effect: Quill shows not sharing (and stops the native presentation) while other participants still see you as sharing a dead screen; no endGroupCallScreenSharing is sent
fix: One ScreenShare enum (Idle, Offering, Answered, Sharing, Failed) whose Failed exit sends endGroupCallScreenSharing.

title: Join/transport/screen-share stage held as transport_ready + join_payload + transport_error + rejoin + screen_* fields kept in step by hand
trigger: Join, rejoin, drop and screen-share paths each reset a different subset (join.rs:467-471, stream.rs:559-562, controls.rs:64-68, mod.rs:172-182)
effect: No bug proven beyond the others listed; every new path must remember which fields to clear
fix: enum Transport { NoTransport, Offering, AnswerReady(payload), Connected, Failed(err) } plus a ScreenShare enum, reset together on rejoin.

title: A failing connect_group_call is retried after every reducer update because join_payload stays set while transport_ready is false
trigger: Join a call where the engine rejects the join answer (bad device, engine error); any group-call update then arrives
effect: pump_group_call_transport calls pump_one_group_call per update, which re-runs refresh_call_devices, connect_group_call and note_stream_rtmp_info each time; you stay joined on the server with no media and no leave
fix: Transport::Failed(err) consumes the payload; only a rejoin or the Join button starts a new attempt.

title: Failed group camera/mute engine calls are re-issued on every poll for the life of the call
trigger: Engine set_group_camera or set_group_muted keeps failing (device unplugged)
effect: pump_connected_group_calls retries each poll; only transport_error is rate-limited, so the engine is hit and the UI woken repeatedly
fix: Record a Failed(wanted) value in the per-call state and retry only on a change of wanted or a device list change.

title: Stopping a screen share clears the local flags before TDLib answers endGroupCallScreenSharing
trigger: Stop sharing while the end request fails (flood, call already gone)
effect: UI shows not sharing and the native presentation is stopped, while the server may still list the screen as shared; no way back into the Sharing state
fix: ScreenShare::Stopping(request) that becomes Idle on ok and Sharing/Failed on error.

title: Self mute flag is flipped locally but Telegram is told only when your own participant row exists
trigger: Mute or unmute right after joining, before the participant list contains the current user
effect: is_muted_self changes and the engine follows, but toggleGroupCallParticipantIsMuted is never sent; other participants keep the old icon and the next server row can flip the button back
fix: Keep an intended-mute value to send once the row arrives, or send it by group call id for self.

title: An unwanted Rejoin offer is dropped without attempt_unsent, leaving rejoin InFlight on a request that is no longer pending
trigger: Rejoin offer is waiting for the payload while left_group_call is set for it or chats_path_active turns false
effect: GroupCallRejoin stays InFlight; maybe_auto_rejoin never restarts it (rejoin_tracked returns the dead request id unless manual), only the manual Rejoin button recovers
fix: finish_offer's unwanted branch must call undo_offer for every OfferSend, or Rejoin::InFlight must be validated against requests.

title: An unwanted Screen offer leaves screen_share_pending true with no offer or request behind it
trigger: Screen share offer lands after the call stopped being joined or chats_path_active turned false
effect: UI shows share starting until the user presses the toggle again (the toggle's pending branch recovers)
fix: Same fix as the rejoin offer: undo_offer on every unwanted branch.

title: join_as_requested is a started flag set before getVideoChatAvailableParticipants and never cleared by an error or send failure
trigger: Open a video chat while the send fails or the answer errors (error.rs treats it as optional)
effect: The join-as picker is never offered for that tracked call; join goes ahead as yourself
fix: Fetch<JoinAsList> on the call (Idle, Loading(request), Ready, Failed).

title: Share-link generation is generating: bool beside two Option links, hand-reset on a send failure
trigger: Press Share Invite Link; the second (speaker) send fails after the listener request went out
effect: generating is forced false while the listener request is still in flight; a second press can send the listener request twice (harmless)
fix: Each link as Fetch<String>; generating is derived.

title: Call link flow spread over call_link, call_link_confirm and call_link_after_leave
trigger: Open a call link while in another call, confirm leave; or the fetch_group_call after offer_call_link fails
effect: call_link keeps the hash after a failed fetch; call_link_after_leave waits on active_call.is_some(), which stays Some through the 1:1 call's Discarded end screen, so the link is not offered until the user dismisses it; there is no cancel for the queued offer
fix: enum CallLinkFlow { Idle, Confirming(..), LeavingThenOffer(..), Offered(..) } cleared on every exit.

title: Start Streaming closes the RTMP box as soon as createVideoChat is sent, not when it succeeds
trigger: Press Start Streaming; TDLib rejects createVideoChat (no rights, flood)
effect: The box is gone with only an error toast; the URL/key just fetched are lost and the user starts over
fix: RtmpStart::Starting(request) closed on the ok answer, reopened with the error on failure.

title: A stream reply of Left stops the transport and clears the payload but starts no rejoin and leaves the call tracked and joined
trigger: A stream part request answers GROUP_CALL_LEFT while TDLib still reports the call joined
effect: No media and no automatic recovery; transport_ready false, join_payload empty, so neither the connect pump nor auto rejoin acts until an updateGroupCall
fix: Route Left through rejoin.want() or a Transport::Lost variant the UI shows with Rejoin.

title: no_chat holds one call id; a second call opened before its chat loads overwrites the first
trigger: Open two calls from links before their chats are known (call + live story)
effect: The first call is never moved to its chat key and its stream feeder never starts
fix: HashSet/Vec of call ids waiting for a chat.

title: A conference join is pending_conference + conference_crypto(PENDING key) + group_offers[PENDING] + a native instance kept in step by hand
trigger: Join/invite/upgrade a conference, fail or cancel at each step (conference.rs:188-203, :280-283, offers.rs:316-319)
effect: No bug proven; every exit must clear all four and tests only cover some
fix: One ConferenceJoin enum owned by the driver with a single teardown.

title: extras_requested is set before the three live-story requests; a send failure aborts the rest and an error answer is never retried
trigger: Watch a non-stream live story; getLiveStoryStreamer errors or its send fails
effect: streamer stays None for the whole watch, so live_story_live_key returns None and no picture is drawn; top donors/senders may never load; only reopening the story retries
fix: Three Fetch<T> fields on LiveStoryState, requested while Idle, retried from Failed on a user action.

title: Undo drops the local pending Stars before removePendingLiveStoryReactions is sent
trigger: Tap Undo while the send fails
effect: Local pending reaction is gone but TDLib still holds the pending Stars and the toast says they were dropped
fix: Keep pending_reaction as Undoing(request) until ok.

title: AddPending error rolls pending stars back but not committed_stars after a commit already took the reaction
trigger: Tap Stars, window elapses and commit goes out, then the earlier addPending answers with an error
effect: pending is None so nothing is subtracted; committed_stars and the flying-stars effect stay as if sent
fix: Pending reaction as an enum of Adding/Held/Committing with each answer matched to its stage.

title: Deleting live story comments removes them locally at once with no restore when deleteGroupCallMessages errors
trigger: Delete a comment (or all from a sender) and the request fails
effect: Comments vanish until the call is rejoined although they still exist
fix: Mark messages Deleting(request) and drop them on ok, restore on error.

title: Channel membership probe runs only for session.open_chat, the main window's chat
trigger: Open a channel or supergroup in a chat window while the main window shows another chat
effect: my_member_status / my_rights_fetched are never fetched for it, so the composer gate and join/leave affordance use defaults
fix: Drive the probe from the set of chats shown in any window (ChatUi / WindowSlot).

title: Topic selection and history paging are keyed by session.open_chat/open_topic, single slots shared by every window
trigger: Open a forum topic in a chat window while the main window has another chat/topic open
effect: select_topic/fetch_topic_history/fetch_topic_history_newer/topic_jump_to_latest act on the main window's chat or fail with InvalidRequest, so the chat window's topic never pages
fix: Take (ChatId, topic) from the caller's ChatUi, not from the session.

title: check_pending/check_failed/check_generation are set before checkChatUsername and not cleared when the send fails
trigger: Type a link in the Type box when the send fails (client closing)
effect: The field shows checking with no request to answer it until the next keystroke
fix: enum UsernameCheck { Idle, Checking{generation,text}, Result{..}, Failed } set only after a successful send.

title: The rest of a basic-group Save is silently dropped when the upgraded chat is not known yet
trigger: Save the Type/Edit box of a basic group; the upgrade answers before upgraded_chat_for resolves
effect: Title, description, photo and link edits queued in EditAfterUpgrade are discarded with no error; the box already closed as saved
fix: Keep the EditAfterUpgrade until upgraded_chat_for resolves, or report an error when it cannot.

title: revoke_public_link sets no revoke tracker when the second send fails after the first went out
trigger: Revoke a public link; send of disableAllUsernames fails after setSupergroupUsername was sent
effect: The username is cleared on the server but the limit box shows nothing in progress and no failure
fix: Create the PublicLinkRevoke before sending and mark failed on any send error.

title: The boost box stage is BoostPhase plus reassigning, note and the session's boost_intent kept in step by hand
trigger: reassign_boosts, send_boost_chat failure, request_chat_boost, and error.rs:529-545 each set a different subset
effect: No bug proven; reassigning must be cleared together with phase at each exit
fix: Fold reassigning into BoostPhase::Working{reassign: Option<ReassignSummary>}; make the intent part of that variant.

title: A second unrestrict-boost-count change while one is in flight is dropped with Ok(None)
trigger: Change the unrestrict boost count twice quickly
effect: The second value is lost without a message; the field shows the later value while the server has the first
fix: Queue the latest value and send it when the first answers, or disable the control while pending.

title: Chat photo emoji icons are icons + chat_photo_emoji_icons_failed + an in-flight purpose
trigger: Open the photo builder, fail, reopen
effect: Reset by hand at load_chat_photo_emoji_icons; no bug today
fix: Fetch<Vec<StickerItem>>.

title: Appending a boosts page never sets BoostsListState::loading
trigger: Open a channel's Boosts list, click 'Show more'; the button stays because loading is still false, click again
effect: No spinner, a second getChatBoosts with the same offset is sent and the first answer is dropped (request id no longer matches); wasted requests
fix: Make the list a Fetch-like enum (Idle/Loading{request,append}/Ready/Failed) so request and loading cannot disagree; derive loading from the request

title: BoostsListState is loading:bool + error + request:Option kept in step by hand
trigger: open_chat_boosts / load_more_chat_boosts / answer / error arms
effect: append path forgets loading (see 02-P6-001)
fix: enum BoostsPage { Loading{request,append}, Ready, Failed } with the loaded rows kept beside it

title: A failed send of a next-page request deletes the already loaded list
trigger: Scroll to 'Show more' in boosts / invite-link members / link join requests / join request search while the sender is down
effect: The loaded rows vanish (list removed or closed) instead of keeping them with an error; same pattern at invite_admin.rs:294 (members), links_boosts.rs:219 (join requests), invite_admin.rs:69 (search drops the previous list)
fix: On append failure only clear the in-flight request and set error on the existing Ready state; remove the entry only for the first page

title: InviteLinkMembersState holds loading:bool, error and request:Option together
trigger: open_chat_invite_link_members / load_more / answer
effect: three fields set by hand in request_invite_link_members (append sets loading/error/request, fresh sets all)
fix: One enum stage carrying the request id

title: Join request search uses three maps (join_request_latest, join_request_queries, join_requests=Loading) as one stage
trigger: search_chat_join_requests / load_more_chat_join_requests; load_more treats join_request_latest.contains_key as 'loading'
effect: Stage spread over maps; removed in answer and error arms by hand (error.rs:234-252, apply.rs:479)
fix: Put query and latest request id inside JoinRequestFetch::Loading/Loaded

title: Welcome messages: welcome_messages map plus welcome_message_fetches enum plus a pending-purpose check decide one 'is it loading' answer
trigger: load_chat_welcome_messages
effect: dedupe checks contains_key(welcome_messages) OR has_purpose; the Loading marker is a second source of truth
fix: Fold the cached pack into WelcomeMessagesFetch::Ready

title: add_chat_welcome_message dedupes by purpose across all chats, with no feedback
trigger: Start adding a welcome message in chat A, add one in chat B before A answers
effect: The second add returns Ok(None) silently; the user's text is not sent and no error shows (edit/delete dedupe per chat)
fix: Use has_purpose_for_chat like edit/delete, and surface the refusal

title: switch_language sets state.switching then returns early on a send error and nothing clears it
trigger: Pick a language while the TDLib sender fails once (closing/unavailable client): add_custom_server_language_pack, set option or getLanguagePackStrings send returns Err via ?
effect: settings.language.switching stays Some with no strings coming; language_ui.rs:204 treats it as 'in flight' so picking the same language again returns early; the reload path (drain_language) also waits for switching.is_none(). Stuck until restart/account switch
fix: Set switching only after all requests are sent, or clear it (and drop the generation) in the Err arm; model as enum Switch { Idle, Switching{generation,..} }

title: Language flow: packs_loading:bool, switching:Option, current:Option, reload:bool, error:Option, ready:Option one-shots
trigger: request_language_packs, switch_language, adopt_saved_language, drain_language
effect: reload is replaced to false by drain_language even when it was not acted on because switching.is_some() (state/.. drain at language_ui.rs:245) so a 'reload' is lost
fix: enum LanguageFlow plus a typed one-shot queue (LanguageEvent) instead of three one-shot fields

title: GiftPurchase is loading + sending + completed + note + quote/price Options
trigger: fetch_marketplace_gift / buy_marketplace_gift / answers in payments/apply.rs:102-160 and error.rs:48
effect: Stages are bools set/cleared in three places; money (Stars/TON) is spent in this flow, answers matched by purpose only, not request id
fix: enum GiftPurchaseStage { Loading{req}, Quoted, Sending{req}, Sent, Failed } and match answers by request id

title: gift_text_length_max fetch error is ignored and a comment then silently blocks the purchase
trigger: getOption send fails once (or answers an error), then buy with a comment
effect: buy_marketplace_gift returns InvalidRequest (max.is_none_or) without setting a note; the Buy button does nothing
fix: Set gift.note on the Err return, and refetch the limit when None

title: GiftCodeLookup carries applying:bool, applied:bool, apply:Option<RequestId>, error and checking request
trigger: request_gift_code_info / apply_gift_code / answers (payments/gift_code.rs)
effect: Answers appear matched by request id (tests in connect/tests/link_info.rs:206), but stage is still bool flags
fix: enum GiftCodeStage { Checking, Ready(info), Applying{req}, Applied, Failed }

title: MasksState keeps open, strip_wanted, failed, installed_loaded, archived_loaded, set_requested as independent flags
trigger: open_mask_sets, load_editor_masks, pump_masks on every ingest
effect: failed is shared by installed and archived lists; set_requested is cleared only on list change
fix: Per-list Fetch<T> for installed/archived plus a per-set Fetch for the strip; open/strip as one 'wanted' enum

title: set_requested is inserted before mask_request, so a send error marks the set as requested for good
trigger: Open the photo editor Masks strip while sender fails once
effect: That set's stickers are never fetched again until the installed list changes (set_requested.clear in state masks.rs:118); strip shows blank set
fix: Insert into set_requested only after send_json succeeds, or remove it in mask_request's Err arm

title: Disk recovering drains disk_paused then aborts with ? on the first toggle error
trigger: Disk was Low and paused several downloads; disk becomes Healthy while one toggleDownloadIsPaused send fails
effect: disk_paused.drain() and forget_disk_pause already ran for all ids, so the downloads after the failing one stay paused and are never resumed by the disk logic; save_disk_pauses_if_changed is skipped too
fix: Remove each id from disk_paused only after its resume was sent; keep going or leave the rest in the set on error

title: download_user_file scans every message of every loaded history to find a file's origin
trigger: Retry/download a file with no known origin (picker sticker) with big histories loaded
effect: Linear scan over all histories on the UI thread per call
fix: Index file_id -> (chat,message) at insert time

title: set_default_reaction is optimistic and nothing rolls it back
trigger: Settings, Quick reaction: pick a reaction; TDLib answers an error (e.g. not premium for custom emoji)
effect: session.stickers.default_reaction keeps the failed choice and shows it as set; SetDefaultReactionType has no error arm anywhere (grep only finds purpose.rs)
fix: Store the previous value on the pending request (RequestRollback) like toggle_sign_messages does

title: Send pipeline: history paging and sends use open_chat/open_topic ambient state (send_topic only knows the topic for session.open_chat) with SendPlace as the fix for deferred voice/video notes only
trigger: send_animation, send_sticker, send_album_snapshot, send_paid_media_snapshot, send_snapshot compute send_topic/thread_routed at call time
effect: Safe only while callers wrap in in_view_of/with_window_chat; every new caller must remember to
fix: Pass SendPlace (fixed at Send) to every send function, as the voice/video-note _to variants do

title: ffprobe/ffmpeg run synchronously on the UI thread when the snapshot was not prepared
trigger: Send media whose background preparation has not finished (or edit with a replacement video: edit.rs:86 probe_local_video)
effect: media_send_path/video_probe/video_note/local_animation fall back to send_path_for / probe_local_video / probe_with_ffprobe / write_video_note_thumbnail; doc comment itself says 'can wait on ffmpeg'. UI freeze for large videos
fix: Make unprepared snapshots a not-ready stage that waits for the background job instead of computing inline

title: Deferred caption: row is rewritten to the new caption and the edit error is discarded
trigger: Edit the caption of a pending upload, then the send succeeds and editMessageCaption fails to send (or is refused)
effect: set_caption mutates the local row first and `let _ = self.edit_snapshot` drops the Err: the row shows a caption the server never got. Also an entry in deferred_captions whose message disappears without a send outcome (chat deleted, account state reset) is never removed
fix: Keep the old caption on the pending record and restore it (with a toast) when the edit fails; drop entries when the message leaves history

title: AI text answers go through one single-slot Option and replace whatever the draft is now
trigger: Press Fix with AI, keep typing (or start another AI action in a second chat window) before the answer lands
effect: MessagesState::ai_composer_text (core/mod.rs:793) holds one (chat, text): a second answer overwrites the first, the answer replaces the newer draft, and an answer for a chat whose window closed stays forever (window_upkeep.rs:229 only takes it when ours)
fix: Carry a draft revision/token (as AiComposePurpose::BoxCompose{token} does) and queue answers per chat

title: Forwarding: in_flight_forward:Option plus queued_forward_flights:Vec as a hand-run queue
trigger: forward_messages_with_options (share box to several chats)
effect: First takes the slot, the rest queue; promotion happens in session_forward.rs:168-176; session_updates clears both
fix: Single Vec<ForwardFlight> with a state per flight (Sending/Done), no special 'main' slot

title: delete_selected ignores can_be_deleted_for_all_users that delete_confirmed honors
trigger: Select several own old messages in a basic group and Delete for everyone
effect: revoke is sent as true when all are outgoing; TDLib refuses the ones past the window and the whole batch fails
fix: Pass per-message can_revoke into the selection delete

title: Account/chat export: Option<Export> as the 'running' flag, WorkerLink.pending Option as in-flight request
trigger: start_account_export / pump_export / answer
effect: Guard `account_export.is_some()` means 'running' until the UI clears it; fail_send/answer must clear link.pending
fix: enum ExportStage { Idle, Running(handle), Finished(result) } owned by the box

title: NewChatState::creations entries are never removed
trigger: Create groups/channels repeatedly in one session
effect: grep finds no remove/retain/clear on creations: every create request stays with its outcome (and any unused photo path) until the account session ends
fix: Remove the entry when the dialog leaves the Creating stage (Farewell) or when the outcome is consumed

title: Revoked-link fetches use my_user_id.unwrap_or(0) as creator
trigger: Open revoked links before getMe has answered
effect: Request is sent for creator 0 and the cached Loaded list is for the wrong creator or errors
fix: Refuse (Ok(None)) until my_user_id is known
